title: IMU50: a high-frequency multi-modal wrist-worn IMU dataset of 50 subjects over 5 continuous days for supervised and self-supervised learning in free-living conditions
repository_note: The archive is approximately 46.7 GB and is intentionally not committed to this repository. Download it locally only if the team confirms it is needed and has sufficient storage.
fit_note: This record is an IMU dataset. Confirm that it contains the PPG and CGM fields needed for PulseCast before using it as the primary source.
